memoryBuilder.verseText: God said: 'I AM. Tell them I AM has sent you.'

sequence.prompt: What happened at the burning bush? Put it in order.

items.label: He saw a bush on fire, not burning up
God said, 'I AM has sent you'

matches.prompt: Match each part of the story to what it means.
matches.questionTemplate: What does the story say about {left}?

pairs.right: It burned but did not burn up
Moses had to take off his sandals
Nobody made God — He always was

application.question: God is holy, and God is right here. Where do you most want to remember that God is with you?

options.label: When I am on my own

application.followUp: God's name means He is always there — He has no beginning and no end. Wherever you go, I AM is already there.
